description: Compare WhatsMyName and MyRecon for whatsmyname alternative. Review current scope and evidence limits, then try a public username search.
h1: MyRecon vs WhatsMyName: compare public-search workflows
intro: Looking for a WhatsMyName alternative depends on the task: WhatsMyName is described by its official source as an open-source username search project and site list. MyRecon is a browser route into a public username search. This page compares workflow and fit without inventing a speed score or claiming identical coverage.

sections.heading: What WhatsMyName is designed to do
sections.body: WhatsMyName is described by its official source as An open-source username search project and site list. Its published workflow is a community-maintained site list and analyst-controlled workflow. Confirm current access, terms, and available features directly with the provider before relying on a capability for a live investigation.

sections.heading: Where a MyRecon username workflow fits
sections.body: MyRecon starts from a username and is intended to help review public profile leads across supported checks. Open every candidate source yourself: a handle match is not proof of identity, and unsupported, blocked, or unavailable checks should not be read as a confirmed absence.

sections.heading: Compare evidence rather than headline counts
sections.body: The tools can use different inputs, data sources, and result rules, so an unmeasured count or speed claim would not be a fair comparison. For WhatsMyName, check the official documentation linked below; for either workflow, confirm the original source, date, and reason a result is relevant.

cta.label: Search a public username with MyRecon

faq.question: Is MyRecon a direct replacement for WhatsMyName?
faq.answer: Not for every task. WhatsMyName is documented as an open-source username search project and site list. MyRecon focuses on a browser-based public username workflow. Choose based on required inputs, access model, source coverage, and the current official documentation.

faq.question: Does MyRecon check more sites than WhatsMyName?
faq.answer: No measured, same-scope benchmark is published here, so this page makes no coverage or speed superiority claim. Compare the current source lists, methods, and result definitions under the same authorized test conditions.

faq.question: Can either tool prove two profiles belong to one person?
faq.answer: A matching username alone cannot establish identity. Open the underlying public profiles and corroborate any proposed connection with independent, voluntarily published context; keep uncertain outcomes clearly labeled.
